tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// snyan rgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i khrid yig rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs pa gsal bar byed pa zung 'jug mchog gi gseng lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// na ma shri badzra dha rā ya/ zab zhing spros pa'i rdul phreng yongs bral 'dus ma byas pa chos dbyings lha lam yangs par gnas// longs spyod yongs rdzogs cha shas rab gang ldan skyes bde chen ri dwags gzugs bsnyan rnam par bkra// sna tshogs sprul pa'i 'od dkar snang bas sgrib pa'i mun bcom nang gi zla ba rdul bral nyid/ khyab bdag bla ma rdo rje sems dpas snying gi ku mud bde chen sbrang rtsis lci bar mdzod// gzhom du med pa'i thig le di ni e wam̐ la sogs zung du 'jug pa'i bdag nyid kho na ste/ khu ba rdul dang mun pa rnams ni rdo rje gsum du rnam par dag pas sku gsum rang bzhin can// gnas skabs bzhi yi 'khrul pa mtha' dag phyag rgya rnam bzhis nges par bcing las bcom ldan sku bzhi nyid// phung lnga dag pas ye shes lnga ldan sku lnga'i bdag nyid shri he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ chos kyi dbyings zhes gcig sdu nyid ni du ma'i gar bsgyur snang srid kun gyi khyab bdag sgyu ma'i dngos// dbu ma'i rang bzhin gnyug ma'i yid ni lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba chen po gcig pu'i rang bzhin nyid// rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin mthar mngon du skyes pa'i rnam pa kun mkhyen dpe yis mtshon pa gang*/ shes rab phar phyin rnal 'byor ma zhes lha mo'i ming gi bod pa de la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// gdul bya sna tshogs 'dul ba mtha' yas pa'i// skad kyis dam chos rgyun mi chad ston pa// khyab bdag rje btsun bla ma'i gsung rdo rje// gsang ba bsam mi khyab der phyag 'tshal lo// de yi bka' drin nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis// legs bskyang bdag blo puṇḍa ri ka'i tshal// legs bshad zil dngar 'thul 'di mthong ba na// skal bzang rkang drug dga' ba'i glu len snyam// tshe 'dis rdo rje 'chang ba ni// 'grub par byed pa snyan rgyud kyi// gdams pa zab mo dbye ba las// dbyings kyi mkha' 'gros gnang ba mdzod// de yang*/

mdo rgyud thams cad kyi snying po las kyang ches snying por gyur pa dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud chen po rnams su sbas pa'i tshul gyis bstan cing*/ dpal rdo rje 'chang chen pos legs par bshad pa/ grub thob chen po rnams kyis gsal bar mdzad pa/ skal ba bzang po dang ldan pa rnams kyis thob pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor phyar ba tsam gyis mchog gi dngos grub char du bsnyil ba yid bzhin nor bu rnam gsum/ snyan rgyud rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhes bya ba'i khrid rim 'chad pa la/ phyi sgro 'dogs gcod par byed pa sprul sku'i gdam pa brgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu/ nang nyams len longs spyod rdzogs sku'i gdam pa smin lam yid bzhin nor bu/ gsang ba ngo sprod chos sku'i gdam pa grol lam yid bzhin nor bu dang gsum las/ dang po/ phyi sgro 'dogs gcod par byed pa sprul sku'i gdams pa brgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu ni/ e ma ho/ sangs rgyas kun gyi yang dag gsang ba mchog /nas/ mkha' 'gros nyon/ zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan pa ltar/ 'og min gyi gnas su dpal rdo rje 'chang gis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la bshad/ des tilli pa la bshad/ de nas rim bzhin nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la ras chung pa/ khyung tshang pa/ kong jo/ zhang lo/ rda ra shri/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ sras mo kun ldan ras ma/ bde legs rin chen/ chos rje kun dga' dpal te brgyud pa bcu gsum gyi bar du chig brgyud du gnang zhing*/ de nas rgyal dbang rje/ ngag dbang chos rgyal/ padma dkar po nas rim bzhin brgyud de/ bdag cag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' 'drin 'khor med ngag dbang mi pham bstan pa'i nyi ma las legs par thob pa'i skal bzang du gyur pa'o// gnyis pa nang nyams len longs spyod rdzogs sku'i gdams pa smin lam yid bzhin nor bu bshad pa la/ ston byed slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid ni/ bslab gsum brgyud ldan nyams myong bla ma'i mchog

/ces gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'o// bstan bya slob ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ dad btson shes rab snying rje'i slob ma ni/ zhes pa'i mtshan nyid rnams tshang ba dgos so/ nyes dmigs dran pas tshe 'di'i bya ba btangs/ zhes pa ni/ gong du bstan pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i bla mas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma la/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' sogs blo ldog rnam pa bzhi'i khrid rim legs par bshad de slob mas kyang don yid la bsam nas rgyud dang 'dres nges su bsgoms nas tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad ling gis btang bar bya'o// thog mar 'khor lo sdom pa la bsten nas/ zhes pa nas/ smin par byas nas/ zhes pa yab bka' rgyas pa 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ 'bring po lha bcu gsum ma/ rigs 'dus lus dkyil/ bsdus pa lhan skyes te bzhi dang*/ yum bka' rgyas pa lha mo bco lnga/ 'bring po lha bdun ma/ bsdus pa lhan cig skyes ma dang gsum ste bdun/ yab bka' lhan skyes la dbang med pas/ gzhan drug po yongs su rdzogs pa bskur nas rgyud smin nges su bya'o// gsum pa gsang ba ngo sprod chos sku'i gdams pa grol lam yid bzhin nor bu la gsum las/ dang po bum dbang dang 'brel ba bsgom bya gtso bor ston pa thun mong yid bzhin nor bu ni/ thabs shes zung du sgrol/ zhes pa ste/ thabs yab kyi bskyed rim dang*/ shes rab yum gyi bskyed rim gnyis zung 'jug tu nyams su len dgos tshul spyir bshad nas/ rgyal po blon dmangs rnal 'byor bdun la 'bad/ ces pas so sor bshad pa ste/ dang po rgyal po chos nyid mi 'gyur ba bskyed rim la/ yab bka' rgyas pa drug cu rtsa gnyis pa dang*/ 'bring po bcu gsum ma/ rigs 'dus lus dkyil/ yum bka' rgyas pa lha mo bco lnga ma/ 'bring po lha bdun ma/ bsdus pa lhan cig skyes ma dang gsum las/ yab yum gyi bskyed rim rgyas pa bsgom na legs mod/

brgyud pa 'di yi bla ma gong ma rnams kyis yab bka' lha bcu gsum ma bsgom pa zab par gsungs pas de dang*/ yum bka' lhan cig skyes ma'i bskyed rim bsgom pa gtso bor bya'o// blon po rigs gsum las byed la/ bla ma mchod pa/ rdor sems bsgom bzlas/ dbang len pa gsum ni yar rgyal po'i bya ba sgrub pa lta bu/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang*/ dpa' bo dpa' mo'i ston mo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma mchod pa ni bar blon po rang gi bya ba lta bu/ sbyin bsreg ni mar 'bangs kyi bya ba byed pa lta bu de rnams la brtson pa'o// dmangs phal pa phrin las mthun sbyor ni/ rnal 'byor bdun la 'bad/ ces pa ste khrus maṇḍal/ zab gos/ 'gro 'dug gnyid de thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor bdun la 'bad pa'o// bsre ba ro snyoms/ zhes pa mdor dril na/ bskyed rim gsal ba bum dbang gi nyams len/ gsal ba'i ngo bo stong pa gsang dbang*/ gsal stong gnyis med kyi bde ba sher dbang*/ gsal stong dbyer med kyi bde ba skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba tshig dbang gi nyams len yin pas bsre ba// bskyed rim rang la'ang dbang bzhi'i nyams len rdzogs pa ni ro snyoms pa ste smin lam dbang dang bsre ba'o// bskyed rim gsal ba bum dbang gi dam tshig gsal ba'i ngo bo stong pa gsang dbang*/ gsal stong dbyer med kyi bde ba sher dbang*/ gsal stong bde ba zung du 'jug pa dbang bzhi pa'i dam tshig yin pas bsre ba/ bskyed rim pas dam tshig shugs kyis bsrung ba ni ro snyoms te dam tshig dang bsre ba'o// zhal phyag gi rnam pa can lha sngags su gsal ba bskyed rim gyi lam/ gsal ba'i ngo bo stong pa rdzogs rim gsal stong dbyer med nyams myong gi bde ba zung 'jug /gsal stong dbyer med kyi bde ba skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba ni phyag rgya chen po'i lam yin pas bsre ba/ bskyed rim la lam bzhi rdzogs pa ni ro snyoms te grol byed lam dang bsre ba'o// bskyed rim rnam pa gsal ba gzugs sku/

ngo bo stong pa chos sku/ nyams myong bde ba longs sku/ 'od gsal 'gro 'ong med pa ngo bo nyid sku'am lhan cig skyes pa'i sku yin pas bsre ba/ bskyed rim bsgom pas sku bzhi rang shugs kyis thob pa ro snyoms te 'bras bu dang bsre ba'o// gnyis pa spyi dang 'brel ba bsrung bya gtso bor ston pa dam tshig yid bzhin nor bu ni/ dam tshig gsum la sbyar/ zhes pa/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las gsungs pa'i/ grol ba zab pa'i dam tshig dad pa 'phel bar byed pa rgya che ba'i dam tshig /dngos grub kyi rgyu zung 'jug gi dam tshig gsum ste/ tilli pa'i gzhung chung gi 'grel par gsal bar bshad pa ltar mi 'da' bar srung ba'o/ gsum pa mchog dbang dang 'brel ba de kho na nyid gtso bor ston pa gnas lugs yid bzhin nor bu la/ gsang dbang dang 'brel ba rtsa rlung gi gnad steng sgo rnam par grol ba/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang 'brel ba mkha' 'gro'i gsang sgrogs 'og sgo bde ba chen po tshigs dbang dang 'brel ba phyag rgya chen po ye shes gsal byed/ lam blo nas chod pa bar do lam khyer/ cig char bas bya spyod tshogs su bsgyur ba'i gdam ngag dang lnga las/ dang po gsang dbang dang 'brel ba'i rdzogs rim rtsa rlung gi gnad steng sgo rnam par grol ba la/ gtum mo bde drod rang 'bar/ sgyu lus chos brgyad rang grol/ rmi lam 'khrul pa rang sangs/ 'od gsal ma rig mun bral/ 'pho ba gser 'gyur gyi rtsi/ grong 'jug sbrul lpags 'dor len dang drug yod la/ dang po gtum mo la'ang*/ steng rang byung ye shes su sbar nas steng rlung gi las 'don/ 'og zag med bde chen du spar nas 'og sgo'i bcud 'don/ bar 'khor 'das rgyun gcod du spar nas rtsa rlung gi ching ston pa gsum las/ dang po steng rang byung ye shes su sbar nas steng rlung gi las ston pa gtum mo bsgom pa la/ thog mar zur gsal ltar/ skyabs sems nas bzung phyi nang gsang ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor rdzogs kyi bar sngon 'gro rnams rgyas par btang ba'am/

bsdu na skyabs sems kyi mthar gsang ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa tsam bya'o// gtum mo bde drod rang 'bar lam gyi gzhung*/ zhes gsungs pa gzung 'dzin gyi dngos por 'dzin pa thams cad za bas na gtum zhing*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes skyed pas na mo ste gtum mo zhes bya'o// phyi'i rkyen la ma ltos par nang gi a shad kyi mes bde drod rang 'bar 'byung ba lam gyi gzhung shing lta bu ste/ de la'ang phyi'i gtum mo lus kyi gnad nang gi gtum mo dmigs pa'i gnad/ gsang ba'i gtum mo rlung gi gnad/ de kho na nyid kyi gtum mo dpyid thig gi gnad dang bzhi las/ dang po phyi'i gtum mo ni/ lus gnad bdun ldan/ zhes gsungs pa 'di la bzhed srol mang yang phyag len dngos ni/ rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung gis gsang rtsa bcar bas thur sel gyi rlung zin pa dang*/ lag pa'i mthe bong gnyis kyis srin mdzub kyi rtsa mnan zhing*/ lag rgyab kyis brla rtsa mnan pa'i mnyam bzhag gis me mnyam gyi rlung dang*/ gru mo dang rgal tshigs bsrang bas khyab byed kyi rlung dang*/ dpung mgo rgyab tu 'phul nas mthong kha yangs par byas pas srog 'dzin gyi rlung dang*/ ol kos gre mdud gnon zhing yid tsam gug pa dang*/ lce ya rkan du sbyar zhing so mchu bar cung zad yod par byas pas gyen rgyu'i rlung dang*/ mig sna rtse'i bar snang la bltas pas yan lag gi rlung lnga zin pa'i dgos pa yod la/ rnam snang gangs can mtsho'i bzhugs stangs dang mthun pas sam/ gzugs sbyangs nas rnam par snang mdzad du phyed pa'i phyir rnam snang gi chos bdun zhes bya'o// gnyis pa nang gi gtum mo dmigs pa'i gnad ni/ lha sku stong ra'i nang*/ zhes pa/ dkar cha dag pa yab 'khor lo sdom pa dang*/ dmar cha dag pa yum rdo rje phag mo gnyis res mos su bsgoms te thabs shes zung sbrel su bya dgos pas/ gzung 'dzin gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba rtsa ba phra ba thur zug cing gdengs ka che ba gyen du bstan pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab kyi steng du padma dang nyi ma 'jig byed dus mtshan gyi gdan la rang nyid 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes yab yum rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa ye shes kyi me dbus na bzhugs pa'i lus kyi nang dbus drang por/

chos nyid kyi rtsa dbu ma drang zhing 'grengs pa chu shing gi sdong po lta bu/ dmar zhing snum pa rgya skyegs kyi khu ba lta bu/ 'jam zhing srab pa padma'i 'dab ma lta bu/ gsal zhing dwangs pa til mar gyi mar me lta bu ste mtshan nyid bzhi ldan/ yar sne spyi bo'i tshangs bug la zug pa/ mar sne gsang gnas dang 'brel ba khong stong kha bye ba'i rnam pa can du sgom/ de'ang 'der so lta bu'i bem gzugs gdos bcas sha khrag las grub pa lta bu ma yin pa ngo bo stong par sgom/ stong pa'i rang rtsal snang ba/ snang ba'i ngo bo stong pa ste/ snang stong dbyer med 'ja' tshon lta bu'i rang bzhin dbyer med du sgom/ bde ba'i ye shes ches cher rgyas pas nyams bde ba chen por bsgom mo// yang na chos 'byung pad nyi bam ro'i gdan la/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mchan g.yon du yab mtshon pa'i rdo rje'i khaṭwāṃ ga dang bcas pa rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa ye shes kyi me dbus na bzhugs pa'i lus nang rtsa dbu ma gong ltar sgom zhing ngo bo stong pa sogs kyang 'dra'o// gang ltar yang dmigs pa'i rtsal sbyong ba'i phyir spro bsdu'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang lus lha yi stong ra lus tshad tsam gsal ba dang dbu ma sba lcag tsam sgom/ de 'byongs nas rang khang pa dang*/ dbu ma ka ba tsam pa zo ba zhabs med lta bur yar zang mar zang stong sang nge ba phyi gsal nang gsal nas/ rim par ri dang ri rab yul khams/ stong khams/ mtha' yas pa'i bar du rgya bskyed la/ dbu ma'ang de mtshungs je cher bskyod pa dang*/ stong ra ji tsam sgom pa'i lus hril po dbu mas khyab par sgom pa ni spro ba'i rnal 'byor dang*/ de nas nam mkha'i mthar khyab pa tshur lus nas stong khams tsam nas rim par yul khams/ ri rab/ ri dang*/ khang pa/ rang lus/ khru gang*/ mtho gang tsam nas mthar stong ra yungs 'bru tsam dang*/ dbu ma spu nyag tsam du sgom pa ni bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor te dmigs pa'i bogs 'don dang*/

snga mas bying ba dang phyi mas rgod pa sel byed du'ang 'gyur ro// dhū ti la la ra sā 'khor lo bzhi/ zhes pa gang la gnad du bsnun par bya ba'i yul lam rten ni rtsa yin te/ stong ra 'khor lo sdom pa'am/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sngar ltar bsgoms pa'i lus dbus su dhū ti ste dbu ma mtshan nyid bzhi ldan yar sna spyi gtsug dang*/ mar sna lte 'og sor bzhir chos 'byung dmar po kha gyen du bstan pa'i nang na zug pa/ de'i g.yas su ra sā na ste ro ma dmar la dkar ba'i mdangs can g.yon du la la na ste rkyang ma dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can/ de ltar rtsa dbu ma mda' smyug tsam ye shes kyi rang bzhin shin tu rgyas shing 'od 'bar ba/ ro rkyang gnyis sog sbub tsam pa gzung 'dzin sma dbab pa'i phyir du lug rjud kyi rgyu ma ltar rnyid pa'i rnam pa can/ ro rkyang gnyis kyi yar sna glad rgya'i steng nas thur du gug ste sna bug gnyis su zug pa/ mar sna dbu ma'i nang du chud pa/ yi ge gzab ma'i cha'i 'phang lta bu spyi mgrin snying ga lte ba'i gnas bzhir dbu ma dang ro rkyang gcig tu 'brel nas sbub gcig tu gyur pa/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab so gnyis te/ dbu ma'i mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon nas re re gyes pas bzhi/ bzhi las re re gyes pas brgyad/ brgyad las re re gyes pas bcu drug bcu drug la re re gyes pas so gnyis so/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug ste/ dbu ma'i mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon las gong ltar gyes pas bzhi/ de las re re gyes pas brgyad/ de las re re gyes pas bcu drug go /snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad de/ dbu ma las gyes pa bzhi/ de las re re gyes brgyad do// lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi ste/ dbu ma las gyes pa'i rtsa ba bzhi/ de las re re gyes pa brgyad/ de las re re gyes pa bcu drug

/de las re re gyes pas so gnyis/ de las kyang re re gyes pas drug cu rtsa bzhi'o/ 'khor lo bzhi'i rtsa 'dab sdom pas grangs brgyad dang nyi shu yod la/ de las kyang gyes pa'i rtsa 'dab bsam gyis mi khyab pa lus kyi cha shas thams cad la khyab pa 'od rgyud sbub can 'dzing thabs su song ba 'dra ba'i sne mo rnams ba spu'i sgor zug pa kha dang nge bar yod pa'am 'ja' 'od kyis gang bar sgom/ spyi bo dang snying ga'i 'khor lo wam̐ yig bde ba'i rnam pa kha mar sbub pa'i rnam pa/ mgrin pa dang lte ba'i 'khor lo e yig shes rab stong pa'i rnam pa kha yar bzed pa 'khor lo bzhi ka la bsgom pa'i dus kha dog ser po/ sgom pa'i dus drod gtso bor 'don pa'i phyir kha dog dmar por sgom/ rtsa gsum gyis dug gsum dag nas sku gsum thob pa dang*/ 'khor lo bzhis gnas skabs bzhi dag nas sku bzhi thob par byed do// gsum pa gsang ba'i gtum mo rlung gi gnad la/ thog mar 'jam rlung 'bud pa dgu phrug ni/ lus gnad sems skyil/ dmigs gnad stong ra rtsa 'khor dang bcas gsal bzhin pas lag g.yas khu tshur brla steng du kha sbub la/ lag g.yon rdo rje'i khu tshur bcas pa'i mdzub mos sna gshog g.yon pa mnan te/ rlung gnad sna bug g.yas nas rlung 'jam po mis mi tshor tsam du dal bus rngubs la lte 'og tu mnan/ g.yas pa'i mdzub mos sna gshog g.yas pa mnan te sna bug g.yon nas dal bus phyir btang*/ de bzhin du sna bug g.yon nas rngubs te mnan la/ lag g.yon pa'i mdzub mos sna gshog g.yon pa mnan te sna bug g.yas nas btang*/ lag gnyis khu tshur pus steng sbub la sna bug gnyis nas gong bzhin cha mnyam du rngubs la cha mnyam du phyir 'bud pa ni mo rlung ngo*// de nas lag g.yas brla dkyil du sbub pa sogs kyis mo rlung las cung zad drag pa mis tshor tsam gyis lan gsum 'bud pa ma ning gi rlung ngo*// de nas khu tshur brla rtsar sbub la g.yon pa'i mdzub mos sna gshog g.yon pa mnan te g.yas nas drag por rngub pa dang mnyam du lus gnad ma shor bar g.yas kyi dpung pa mdun du bskor la lag g.yas kyi mdzub mos sna gshog g.yas pa mnan te mgrin pa ma yo bar gdong g.yon du phyogs nas g.yon gyi dpung mgo rgyab tu bskor la sna g.yon nas sing sgra dang bcas phyir 'bud/

g.yon nas rngub pa dang mnyam du gdong yang mdun du phyogs g.yon pa'i dpung mgo nang du bskor la lag g.yon gyi mdzub mos sna gshog g.yon pa mnan te gdong g.yas su phyogs la g.yas kyi dpung mgo phyir bskor te g.yas nas sing sgra dang bcas phyir 'bud/ lag gnyis khu tshur brla rtsar sbub la lus gnad ma shor bar dpung mgo gnyis mdun du bskor ba dang lhan cig sna bug gnyis nas cha mnyam du rngub dpung mgo gnyis rgyab tu bskor bar bstun sna bug gnyis nas seng sgra dang bcas phyir 'bud pa ni pho rlung ngo*/ de dag gi dmigs pa ni/ g.yas nas rngub g.yon nas 'bud skabs ro ma'i nang thams cad rlung gis khengs nas sdig sgrib nad gdon rtsa dug rlung dug thig le'i nyes skyon thams cad du ba rlung gis ded pa ltar rkyang ma'i nang brgyud de sna bug g.yon nas phyir thon par bsam/ g.yon nas rngubs shing g.yas nas 'bud skabs rkyang ma rlung gis khengs nas sdig sgrib nad gdon sogs ded nas ro ma'i nang brgyud de sna bug g.yas nas phyir thon par bsam/ gnyis ka nas rngubs shing gnyis ka nas 'bud skabs ro rkyang gnyis rlung gis khengs nas ro ma'i rlung rkyang ma dang*/ rkyang ma'i rlung ro mar bsnol rgyag tu song nas sdig sgrib nad gdon ded nas phyir thob par bsam mo// srung 'khor sgom pa ni/ rang nyid dpal 'khor lo sdom pa yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang bcas par gsal ba'i lus nang rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi a shad me yi rang bzhin dang bcas pa gsal btab la/ rlung phyir dbyung ba mnyam du a gtum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi nus mthu'i bdag nyid las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis/ rgyal ba sras bcas yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi nus byin thams cad me dpung gi rnam par bsdus/ tshur rngub pa dang mnyam du sna bug nas zhugs te a gtum la thim pa dang lhan cig ye shes kyi me cher 'bar bas sdig sgrib bag chags nad gdon sogs nang gi mi mthun phyogs thams cad yongs su bsreg pa'i dud pa dang mnyam du me lce ba spu'i khung bu kun nas 'phros pas phyi rol gyi yul snang thams cad gang bar bsam/

yang rlung dbyung rngub mnan skabs spro bsdu gong ltar bya ba lan gnyis te snga phyi sdom pa'i rlung khug gsum mthar rlung sprug cing ha sgras rlung 'byin pa nas dbang po'i sgo dang ba spu'i bu ga nas 'phros pa'i mes stong gsum gang ba las mtshon cha dang khro tshogs skar ltar 'phro zhing ser ltar 'dril nas yul snang phyir chad kyi bdud bgegs bar chad thams cad dum bur gtub cing gzhob tu bsreg nas rdul phran tsam yang mi dmigs par gyur pa dang*/ khro tshogs me dpung tshur 'dus nas steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad me dpung mtshon cha khro tshogs kyi gur khang gzhom gzhig bral bas gtam par bsam pa dang*/ bsrung bya srung byed ngo bo ma grub pa sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag pas gnyis 'dzin dag pa'i phyir don gyi srung 'khor ro/ rim pa de dag sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du sgrub pa'i mi mthun phyogs rnams gzhom zhing bsrung ba'i rten 'brel yin no/ de nas rlung gi gnad dngos la gsum las/ dang po rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ zhes pa rdo rje'i bzlas pa la dbye ba mang yang 'dir rdzogs rim gyi rdor bzlas bshad de/ rang nyid dpal 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum mam/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lus nang rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi dang bcas pa'i snying ga'i 'khor lo'i dbus dhu ti'i nang du mi shiṭa pa'i thig le dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa zhig bsgom/ sna bug nas rlung nang du 'jug pa oṃ gyis gdangs kyis dbu ma nas byung ste spyi bo/ spyi bo nas mgrin pa/ mgrin pa nas snying kha'i bar du byung bar bsam/ gnas pa'i dus ā'i gdangs kyis snying kha'i mi shigs pa'i thig le la gnas par bsam phyir 'gro ba'i dus hūm̐ gi gdangs kyis snying ga nas mgrin pa/ mgrin pa nas spyi bo/ spyi bo nas sna bug gi phyir thon par bsam/ de ltar rgyun du rlung rang bzhin gyi 'jug gnas ldang gsum la brten pa dang*/

skabs ci rigs par 'jam rlung ched du bzung ba la rdor bzlas bya'o/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa 'di ni bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba dang*/ bshad rgyud lha mo bzhis zhus/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus rim lnga sogs las rgya cher bshad cing bsngags pa shin tu che ste rlung gi rnal 'byor thams cad kyi mchog yin pas yun bsrings te bsgom par bya'o/ gnyis pa rtsa ba'i rlung lnga bsgom pa ni/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga bsgom/ zhes pa ste/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga ni phyi 'byung ba lnga dang sbyar na/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha' rlung dang lnga/ nang lus la sbyar na/ me mnyam/ srog 'dzin/ gyen rgyu/ khyab byed/ thur sel rlung dang lnga ste/ me mnyam pa'i rlung lte ba na gnas/ srog 'dzin chu'i rlung snying ga na gnas/ gyen rgyu me'i rlung mgrin pa na gnas/ khyab byed rlung gi rlung spyi bo na gnas/ thur sel nam mkha' rlung gsang gnas na gnas pas de ltar rtsa ba'i rlung lnga dbang du 'dus na yan lag gi rlung shugs kyis zin par 'gyur bas rtsa ba'i rlung lnga bsgom par bya ste/ rang nyid 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum mam/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lus nang rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga dang bcas par gsal ba'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus su mi shigs pa'i thig le ser po e yig gis mtshan pa sra zhing brtan pa gsal gdab/ sor bcu gnyis tsam nas sa rlung ser po dal bus rngub pa ro rkyang gi lam brgyud de dbu ma'i nang du zhugs pas lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gang ste thig le e yig dang bcas pa la lhag ma ma lus pa thim par bsam/ de bzhin du snying ga'i 'khor lo'i dbus su chu yi dwangs ma thig le dkar po wam̐ yig gis mtshan pa/ bsil zhing snum pa/ mgrin par me'i dwangs ma thig le dmar po ma yig gis mtshan pa dro zhing bde ba/ spyi bor rlung gi dwangs ma thig le ljang gu ya yig gis mtshan pa yangs shing g.yo ba/ gsang bar nam mkha'i dwangs ma thig le sngon po a yig gis mtshan pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa rnams gsal btab la/

sor bcu gsum nas chu rlung dkar po/ bcu bzhi nas me rlung dmar po/ bco lnga nas rlung gi rlung ljang gu bcu drug nas nam mkha'i rlung sngon po rnams bzung ba sogs gong ltar bsgom mo 'di rnams rlung khug gi grangs ka med pas ji ltar nus nus su bsgom mo/ gsum pa bum pa can bsgom pa ni/ srog rtsol thur sel gcun/ zhes pa ste/ de'ang 'grim 'grul mang ba'i sa dang*/ rdul dang dud pa 'tshub pa'i gnas dang*/ 'grangs ches pa dang*/ ltog ches pa'i dus dang*/ nam phyed nyin gung rlung sna bug g.yas nas rgyu ba'i skabs rnams su bzung na gegs yong bas de las ldog pa'i gnas dang dus skabs rnams su bzung 'di ni gtso cher bum pa can bsgom pa'i dus gnad yin kyang rlung gi rnal 'byor gzhan la'ang 'dra'o/ rang 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum mam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi dang bcas pa gsal btab/ phyi'i sor bcu drug tsam nas drangs pa'i mos pas rlung sgra med 'jam por sna bug gnyis nas rngubs la lte 'og tu chil gyis mnan/ 'og rlung yid tsam drangs la kha sbyor du dgang*/ las dang po pas ran tshod tsam du bzung la mi thub tsa na cung zad mnan nas rngubs chung byas te g.yas bcag g.yon bcag dbus bcag nas gzhil mthar cung zad stod dgye ba dang mnyam du sna bug gnyis nas dang po dang mjug tu shed chung zhing bar du shugs che bar sing sgra dang bcas te lhag ma ma lus par phyir dbyung*/ rlung btang tshar dus ji tsam gnas kyi bar phyi 'dzin byas la slar yang rngub pa sogs gong ltar ro/ de'ang lcags kyus dgug pa ltar rlung 'jam por rngubs shing drangs ba dang*/ bum pa gsum gnyis chu yis bkang ba ltar/ lte ba'i nang sum gnyis rlung gis bkang ba/ rgya mdud ltar gzhil zhing lte 'og tu sdom pa/ thogs pa med par mda' ltar 'phang ba ste sbyor ba bzhi dang ldan pas/ steng rlung cha gnyis/ 'og rlung cha gcig kha sbyar byas nas bzung zhing g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab phyogs gcig tu ma yo bar mnan dgos so/

de ltar sbyor ba bzhi ldan gyi dus su dmigs pa ni/ rngub pa'i dus su phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang*/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor sogs yi dam/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer sna lnga'i rnam pa dang*/ sna bug gi sor bcu drug mtshams nas nam mkha'i rlung sngon po bco lnga nas rlung gi rlung ljang gu/ bcu bzhi nas me rlung dmar po/ bcu gsum nas chu rlung dkar po/ bcu gnyis nas sa rlung ser po rnams sna bug nas zhugs/ ro rkyang gnyis nas rgyu mar phus btab pa ltar tha la la song nas rtsa gsum 'dus mdor dgang*/ gzhil ba'i skabs su ro rkyang gi rlung rnams dbu mar pur gyis zhugs nas ye shes kyi rlung yug gcig tu gyur/ phyir 'phang ba'i dus su rlung rnams dbu ma'i nang du lhag med du thim par bsam mo/ de ltar las dang po pas rlung khug bdun re mtshams su yud tsam ngal bso/ rim gyis goms pa na/ nyer lnga/ lnga bcu/ brgya sogs je mangs su btang*/ gang ltar yang mthar khu tshur pus steng du bzhag la pho ba g.yas bskor gsum dang g.yon bskor gsum pho rdeb gsum byas la rdor skyel bshigs nas lag pa sbub ste ha sprug gis lus cha mnyam par si li li sprug go /'di ltar 'jam rlung sbyor ba bzhi ldan 'di nyid la goms pa'i phan yon ni/ dgyes rdor dang*/ shin tu rmad byung gi rgyud las gsungs pa'i snying po tsam ni/ khros pa'i nyams kyis mig 'bras gnyis dpral bar gtad nas rlung dbyung bas shing 'bras sogs lhung ba dang*/ mig gnyis g.yon du bltas nas dgang bas rgyal po sogs dbang du byed pa/ mig gnyis dpral ba'i g.yas logs su bltas nas rngubs pas ri dwags sogs dgug pa dang*/ mig gnyis thad kar bltas nas gzhil bas dmag sogs rengs ba phyi dang*/ gtum mo rang byung du 'bar bas byang sems bzhu ba ltung ba/

bde ba dbang du byed pa/ thig le gsang gnas su dgug pa/ thig le mi 'pho bar byed pa nang dang*/ gnas skabs bzhi'i sgrib pa bral bar byed pas ltung ba/ rtsa rlung thig gsum mi shigs dwangs mar dbang du byed pa/ byang sems gyen du gshegs pas zag pa med pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs dgug pa/ rtsa tshogs chos nyid kyi dbu mar reng pa gzhan te/ de'ang tshogs kyi sa nas phyi/ mos spyod kyi sa nas nang*/ 'phags pa nas gzhan 'grub par gsungs so/ bzhi pa de kho na nyid kyi gtum mo dpyid thig gi gnad ni/ a haṃ 'bar 'dzag ces gsungs te de la gnyis las/ dang po 'bar srod kyi rnal 'byor ni/ rang nyid 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes yab yum mam/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi dang bcas pa sngar bzhin gsal ba'i lte 'og sor bzhi'i thad du/ ro rkyang gnyis dbu ma'i nang du 'dus pa'i sum mdor rdo rje nyi ma snang ba chen po a shad pa lu ta sum 'khyog rtse mo gyen du bstan pa phra sbom mo khab tsam ring thung sor phyed pa/ spu nyag rlung gis bskyod pa ltar lhab lhab tu bskyed pa'i sgra pheṃ pheṃ du sgrog pa/ nyi ma'i chos nyid rnam par dag pas kha dog dmar ba/ rlung me'i drod can gyi ngo bor grub pas reg bya tsha ba/ byang chub kyi sems ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dam pa'i phyir nyams myong bde ba/ chos kyi dbyings shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i ngo bo nyid kyi phyir rang bzhin stong pa nyid de mtshan nyid bzhi dang ldan pa gsal gdab/ yang gcig tu na/ ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ rang bzhin thig le dmar po/ rnam pa me sum 'khyog tu 'bar ba/ reg bya tsha bas rtsa 'khor lus dang bcas pa dro bar nus pa/ byed las drod des tsha ba'i zug rngu byed pa ma yin par bde ba skyed pa'o/ de yang a shad kyi rtsub pa sa/ snum pa chu/ tsha ba me/ bskyod cing g.yo ba rlung*/ stong pa nam mkha' ste khams lnga 'dus yin pas/

sa khams dag pa spyan ma chu khams dag pa ma mā ki/ me khams dag pa gos dkar mo/ rlung khams dag pa sgrol ma/ nam mkha'i khams dag pa dbyings phyug ma ste yum lnga 'dus pa dang*/ ye shes kyi khams rnam par dag pa rdo rje phag mo'i bdag nyid de snyoms pa'i dag pa dran cing nges pa byed pa gal che'o/ de nas 'byung lnga'i rlung kha dog so sor gsal ba sna bug gnyis nas 'jam po rngub pa ro rkyang gnyis nas tha la la song ste a shad la phog pas sol me la rlung phog pa ltar dmar lhang gis song bar bsam la mnan pa'i tshe de kho na la sems gtad/ phyir dbyung dus a shad las 'od zer dmar po 'phros pas lus kyi nang gang*/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas phyir thon/ 'od zer re re'i rtse mor mchod pa'i lha mo lag na mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa la phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa phul bas thugs rgyud mnyes par bsam/ nang du rngub dus gsang gsum gyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par bsdus te 'byung lnga'i rlung dang lhan cig tu sna bug gnyis nas zhugs/ ro rkyang gi lam brgyud de a shad la thim pas nus rtsal bkrag mdangs ches ches rgyas par bsam la mnan yang rlung phyir dbyung dus a shad las 'od zer dmar po 'phros pas lus gang*/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas phyir thon te phyi snod kyi 'jig rten la phog pas ma dag pa thams cad bsregs nas thugs gsung sku'i zhing khams su bsgyur/ tshur rngub dus 'byung ba lnga'i bcud/ khyad par du nyi ma dang rta gdong gi me'i nus bcud thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par bsdus te 'byung lnga'i rlung dang lhan cig tu sna bug gnyis nas zhugs/ ro rkyang gi lam brgyud de a shad la thim pas snga ma las nus rtsal rgyas par bsam la mnan/

yang rlung phyir dbyung dus 'od zer sngar ltar 'phros lha mi klu sogs 'gro ba kun la phog pas sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad bsregs nas 'khor lo gsum gyi lha'i rang bzhin du bsgyur/ tshur rngubs dus sems can thams cad kyi tshe bsod dpal 'byor gzi brjid sogs yon tan thams cad bsdus te 'byung lnga'i rlung dang mnyam du sna bug gnyis nas zhugs pa ro rkyang gi lam brgyud de a shad la thim pas snga ma las kyang nus rtsal bkrag mdangs gzi brjid nus stobs rgyas par bsam la mnan/ rlung phyir btang dus a shad kyi 'od dang tsha ngad bde ba'i shugs kyis rtsa 'khor lus nang thams cad khyab par bsam/ de nas sbyor ba bzhi ldan gyi rlung gis a shad las gtum mo ye shes kyi me tsha ba'ishugs bde ba'i zil dang ldan pa glog 'khyugs pa ltar khra khyug khyug dmar chem chem du sbar la sbyor ba bzhi ldan rlung khug re res me lce je sboms su rim bzhin gyen du sbar la lte ba'i rtsa 'khor dang*/ rkang mthil yan chad mes khengs par bsam/ de nas rim bzhin sbar la snying ga'i 'khor lo/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo lag pa'i sor mo'i rtse tshun chad dang*/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo bcas mes gang bar bsam/ mthar rtsa phran grangs med pa sogs lus kyi nang thams cad me dmar zhing 'bar la tsha ngad dang bde ba mi bzod pas gang ste ba spu'i bu ga nas me lces dmar nyug nyug tu thon te phyir 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad me drag tu 'bar zhing 'khrugs par gyur nas rang lus phyi nang med pa me'i rang bzhin gyur par bsam/ de yang thog mar gtum mo'i mes lte ba'i rtsa 'khor man chad bkang ba kho na la dmigs phug ste bsgom/ de ltar bsgoms pas lte 'og man chad la drod skyes pa na rim bzhin snying ga sogs su gtum mo'i me sbar ba la dmigs pa gtad de bsgom pas drod skye ba myur zhing skyes pa brtan par gsungs so/

mthar rlung nang du rngub pa'i tshe lag gnyis rdo rje'i khu tshur snying gar bsnol/ mnan pa'i dus khu tshur pus khar bzhag pa dang rdor bskyil bshig cing rdeb chung byed pa rnams dus mnyam bya/ de nas rlung mnan bzhin par g.yas gcu g.yon gcu byas la/ de skabs dmigs pa ni/ gtum mo gang du bsgom pa'i rtsa 'khor rnams la me khod snyoms par 'bar bas rtsa zhar ba dang skam pa rnams sos pa dang rtsa mdud thams cad grol bar bsam/ mthar rlung btang ba dang mnyam du ha ha zhes lus byings si li li drag tu sprug go de nas rlung nang du rngub dus gtum mo gang du sbar ba'i steng g-i me thams cad a shad la bsdu/ phyir btang dus smad kyi me thams cad a shad la bsdu/ a shad nyid til mar gyi mar me ltar 'bar zhing gsal ba'i 'od kyis rtsa 'khor lus nang thams cad gsal bar bsam pa la dmigs pa gtad do/ gnyis pa 'bar 'dzag zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor ni/ stong ra rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi a shad dang bcas pa sngar gsal ba'i spyi bo'i dbu ma'i yas sne nang du rdo rje zla ba dri ma med pa'i 'od haṃ yig dkar po mgo mthur bstan bdud rtsi 'dzag la khad pa/ zla ba'i khams kyi cha yin pa'i phyir dkar ba/ thabs kyi rang bzhin shes rab dang 'brel ba'i phyir mu tig gi rdog po ltar 'tsher ba/ byang chub kyi sems bdud rtsi'i bcud dang ldan pa'i phyir snum pa/ rtsa yi gnas gang dang gang yang rung bar spyan 'dren bde ba'i phyir kun nas kun tu zlum pas 'dril ba ste mtshan nyid bzhi dang ldan pa gsal btab/ yang na/ ngo bo dpal he ru ka 'khor lo sdom pa/ rang bzhin thig le dkar po/ rnam pa haṃ yig dkar po/ reg bya bsil ba rtsa gnas dang lus thams cad bsil bar nus pa/ byed las bde ba chen po skyed par byed pa'o/ de yang haṃ yig gi 'jam pa/ snum pa chu/ 'od 'tsher ba me/ g.yo ba rlung*/ stong pa nam mkha'i rang bzhin te khams lnga ldan yin pas/

sa khams dag pa rnam snang*/ chu khams dag pa rin 'byung*/ me khams dag pa snang mtha'/ rlung khams dag pa don grub nam mkha'i khams dag pa mi bskyod pa ste yab lnga 'dus pa dang*/ ye shes kyi khams rnam par dag pa rdo rje 'chang gi bdag nyid do snyam pa'i dag pa dran zhing nges pa skyed par bya dgos so// de nas 'byung lnga'i rlung sna bug gnyis nas 'jam por rngub/ ro rkyang gnyis nas song ste dbu mar zhugs pa a shad la phog pas me lce dmar po phra ba rta rnga tsam pa dmar khyug gis 'bar te dbu ma'i nang nas gyen du song ba haṃ la phog par bsam la mnan pa'i tshe de kho na la sems gtad/ phyir dbyung dus haṃ las 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa 'phros pas lus kyi nang gang spyi bo dang smin mtshams sogs ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir thon/ 'od zer gyi rtse las mchod pa'i lha mo brjod du med pa 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad la phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bla na med pa phul bas mnyes par bsam/ nang du rngub dus de dag gi gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer dkar po bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can gyi rnam par bsdus te 'byung lnga'i rlung dang lhan cig tu sna bug nas zhugs pa ro rkyang gi lam brgyud de haṃ la thim pas nus bsil bde rtsal gzi mdangs rnams ches cher rgyas par bsam la mnan/ yang rlung phyir dbyung dus 'od zer sngar ltar 'phros pa snod kyi 'jig rten la phog pas ma dag pa thams cad sbyangs nas dag pa'i zhing khams su bsgyur/ tshur rngub dus 'byung lnga'i bcud dang lhag par zla ba dang lha'i bdud rtsi'i nus bcud thams cad gong ltar bsdus nas haṃ yig la thim pas snga ma nas kyang nus bsil bde rtsal gzi mdangs rgyas par bsam la mnan/ yang rlung phyir dbyung dus 'od zer sngar ltar 'phros te sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad sbyangs nas 'khor lo gsum gyi lha'i rang bzhin du bsgyur/

tshur rngub dus sems can thams cad kyi tshe bsod dpal 'byor gzi mdangs sogs yon tan thams cad bsdus te haṃ la thim pas snga ma las kyang nus bsil sogs rgyas par bsam la mnan/ rlung phyir btang dus haṃ gi 'od dang bsil ngad bde ba'i shugs kyis rtsa 'khor 'dus nang thams cad khyab par bsam/ de nas sbyor ba bzhi ldan gyi rlung gis a shad las gtum mo'i me tsha ba'i ngad bde ba'i shugs dang ldan pa rim gyis je cher sbar ba'i drod kyis bskul bas haṃ dngos zhu ba ma yin par chu shel la zla zil phog pas chu thigs pa ltar du haṃ las byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar po bsil zhing bde ba'i rang bzhin can dkar na ra ra babs pa a shad kyi me dang 'dres pas bde drod zung 'jug tu rgyas shing lte ba'i chos 'byung yongs du gang bas sdong rtsa mar khus gsos pa ltar gtum mo'i me cher 'bar ba dbu ma'i nang nas gyen du song ste haṃ la phog haṃ las byang sems dkar po'i rgyun cher bab nas spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor yongs su gang bas dga' ba skyes par bsam/ yang byang sems dbu ma'i nang nas dkar nar nar bab ste mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor lag pa'i sor mo'i rtse tshun chad gang bas mchog dga' skyes par bsam/ de bzhin du bab ste snying kha'i rtsa 'khor gang bar khyad dga' skyes par bsam/ lte ba'i rtsa 'khor dang rkang mthil yan chad gang bas lhan skyes kyi dga' ba skyes par bsam/ las dang po pa'i skabs su dga' bzhi skye bar mos pa'i skabs dang*/ rim bzhin goms nas dga' bzhi cung zad de dngos su skye ba sogs kyi skabs thams cad du dga' ba'i ngo bo la bltas nas stong par nges pa'i bde stong dbyer med kyi nyams bskyang*/ 'khor lo rer rlung khug gsum lnga bdun bcu sogs ci nus bya/ mthar rlung nang du rngub pa'i tshe lag gnyis khu tshur snying khar bsnol/ mnan pa dang mnyam du khu tshur pus bzhag dang rdor skyil bshig

rdeb chung bya/ rlung mnan bzhin par/ pho bskor g.yas g.yon dang*/ g.yas gcugayon gcu byas la de skabs dmigs pa ni/ lus nang rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi rtsa phran dang bcas pa'i nang thams cad byang sems dkar pos khod snyoms par khyab pas rtsa zhar ba dang skam pa rnams sos pa dang*/ rtsa mdud thams cad shig shig tu grol bar bsam/ mthar rlung btang ba mnyam du ha ha zhes lus si li li drag tu sprug go /de rjes rlung nang du rngub pa dang mnyam du dbu ma'i nang gi me thams cad a shad la bsdu/ phyir btang ba dang mnyam du lus gcun/ sku zhabs gyen du drangs/ lce ya rkan la sbyar/ mig gyen la blta ba sogs sbyor ba drug ldan 'jam pos rkang pa'i sor rtse yan gyi khams dkar cha thams cad dkar kyi li li dbu ma'i nang nas gyen du drangs te spyi bo'i haṃ la bstim pa ni 'dren yin la/ slar rlung nang du rngubs pa dang mnyam du haṃ las byang sems char ltar babs nas rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi rtsa phran dang bcas pa'i lus nang thams cad snyoms par gang zhing bye ma la chu btab pa ltar khyab par bsam/ mnan pa'i tshe g.yas gcu g.yon gcu sngar ltar dang 'phur srub drag tu byas la ha sprugs bya ba ni bkram pa'o/ de nas 'khor lo bzhi dang ro rkyang dbu ma la bsdu/ dbu ma'i nang thams cad byang sems dkar dmar gyis gang bar bsam la bde stong dbyer med kyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag go /bogs 'don la gnyis las dang po drod kyi bogs 'don ni/ lus gnad rnam snang gi chos bdun nam me thab drug ching gis 'khod la/ rang nyid dpal 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum mam/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sngar bshad pa ltar bsgom pa'i 'og dang mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon rnams su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rab tu tsha zhing 'od 'bar ba re re ste lnga sgram gyi tshul dang*/ lus nang rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi a shad dang bcas pa/ a shad kyi 'og tu raṃ yig dmar po mgar gyi lcags sreg ltar dmar zhing tshwa tshwa 'thul ba/

spyi bor pad nyi'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ rnam pa dpal he ru ka sku mdog dmar po khro 'dzum chags pa'i nyams can/ g.yas zangs kyi gri gug me 'bar ba dang*/ g.yon ka pā la bdud rtsi dmar po zhun mar lta bu khol zhing 'bar bas gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ dbu skra thor tshugs la thod skam rdog gcig rin po che'i rtse phran can gyi dbu rgyan byas pa rus pa'i rgyan drug dang stag sham sogs he ru ka'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing zhabs gnyis phyed skyil gyis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus su bzhugs pa/ nyi ma stong gi gzi brjid 'bar ba mchog gsum rtsa gsum kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bsgoms la rang gi snying ga'i 'od sprin/ las spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo'i tshogs kyis/ phyi mchod snang srid snod bcud longs spyod thams cad dang*/ me dang nyi ma grangs med pa/ nang mchod 'dod yon gyi lha mo lnga drod kyi rang bzhin dang*/ gsang mchod me'i lha mo gos dkar mos snyoms 'jug gi bde ba/ de kho na nyid mchod yul mchod bya mchod mkhan dmigs su med pa blo 'das kyi ngang du mchod la/ khyab bdag dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs so/ gtum mo bde drod kyi ye shes khyad par can bdag gi rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ de nas drag rlung gnad lnga ma ni/ rlung log mi 'byung ba 'bud pa'i gnad/ rang gnas su gzud pa rngub pa'i gnad/ dbang du bsdu ba dgang ba'i gnad/ rtsa mig tu gdab pa gzhil ba'i gnad/ phyi nang bsre ba 'phang ba'i gnad de lnga las/ dang po ni/ 'bud pa dgu phrug gi phyi ma nyid drag tu btang ba dang*/ phyi ma bzhi ni 'jam rlung sbyor ba bzhi ldan rtsol ba drag por byas pa yin no// de ltar drag rlung dang sbrag te sna bug gnyis nas rlung drag tu rngub pa rgyu mar phus btab pa ltar ro rkyang gnyis nas ldi ri ri song ba dang*/ 'og rlung drag tu 'then pa dbu ma'i nang nas gyen du byung ba gnyis rtsa gsum 'dus mdor kha sbyor du dgang la/

steng 'og gi rlung raṃ la phog pas raṃ las me 'bar te a shad la phog pa dang*/ a shad las kyang gtum mo'i me cher 'bar bar bsam/ cung zad mnan sbyor byas te rngub chung brtsegs nas rlung mar g.yas g.yon dbus gsum drag tu bsdig la/ gtum mo'i me dbu ma'i nang nas gyen du dmar khyug khyug song ba dbu ma'i yas sna nas thon te bla ma'i sku la phog pas bde drod kyi ye shes kyis bla ma shin tu rgyas par bsam/ phyir 'phang ba dang mnyam du spyi bo'i bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal ba sras bcas rtsa ba gsum gyi byin rlabs/ snod kyi 'jig rten gyi bcud dang dwangs ma bcud kyi sems can gyi tshe bsod bkrag mdangs gzi brjid thams cad bdud rtsi me yi rnam pa can du bsdus pa bla ma'i phyag gi thod pa'i bdud rtsir thim/ rngub pa'i dus su thod pa'i bdud rtsi shin tu tsha zhing khol ba ye shes kyi me'i rang bzhin can de rang gi spyi gtsug tu blugs pa tshangs bug nas zhugs/ dbu ma'i lam brgyud de a shad me 'bar ba la phog me 'bar ba'i nang du mar khu blugs pa ltar 'ur sgra dang bcas gtum mo'i me tsha ba'i ngad dang*/ bde ba'i shugs mi bzod pa ches cher 'bar bas rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi rtsa phran grangs med lus nang thams cad gang bas drod dang bde ba'i tshor ba bsam gyis mi khyab cing bzod du med pa tsam skyes par bsam la pho skor rtsub rdeb bya/ dgang sprug gi skabs su me lus nang du ma shongs bar me lce ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas phyir 'phros pa nyi ma lngar phog nyi ma lnga las kyang me cher 'bar ba tshur 'phros pa rang gi lus la phog pas/ rang lus me dpung gi g.yogs/ phyir 'phros pas 'jig rten thams cad me dpung tsha dbal mi bzod pas gang zhing snod bcud thams cad rnam pa ma nyams pa la me'i rang bzhin du 'bar zhing 'khrugs par bsams la rlung phyir 'phang*/ thun gcig la gnad lnga dang ldan pa'i rlung khug nyer gcig tsam byas mthar ha sprug g.yas g.yon dbus gsum bya/

mthar bla ma 'od du zhu ba bdud rtsi me'i rnam pa can du gyur te spyi bo nas rtsa gnas lus thams cad khyab par thim par bsam mo/ de ltar gnad ma 'phyug par nyams su blangs na zhag gsum nas drod 'bar zhing zhag bdun nas ras rkyang thub pa gdon mi za bar gsungs so// gnyis pa bde ba'i bogs 'don ni/ lus gnad chos bdun dang*/ dmigs gnad stong ra 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum mam/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lus nang rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga dang a shad haṃ yig gnyis kyang so so'i gnas su dag dran dang bcas te sngar bzhin gsal btab/ rlung phyir btang ba dang mnyam du spyi bo'i haṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam zhi khro dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad dang*/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rtsa ba'i bla ma dang bcas pa dpal 'khor lo sdom pa drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par spyan drangs pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par bsam/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od sprin las spros pa'i rdo rje'i lha mo bcu drug sogs phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la gsol ba 'debs so/ bde stong ye shes khyad par can bdag gi rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ rlung rngub pa dang mnyam du 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar 'dres pa'i rgyun chen po babs pa haṃ yig la thim par bsam/ dgang zhing gzhil ba'i dus 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum rnams rjes chags kyi bde bas 'od du zhu nas haṃ yig la thim pas nus stobs gzi mdangs sogs shin tu rgyas par bsam mthar phyir dbyung*/ de nas 'jam rlung sbyor ba bzhi ldan dang sgrag ste haṃ las byang chub kyi sems bdud rtsi dkar po bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin can dkar na ra ra babs nas spyi bo'i 'khor lo rtsa phran bcas pa dang*/

mgrin pa'i 'khor lo lag sor gyi rtse tshun chad dkar ltem gyis gang bas dga' ba'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsam/ de nas rim gyis dbab te snying ga'i 'khor lo gang bas mchog dga'/ lte ba'i 'khor lo gang bas khyad dga'/ gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo rkang sor yan gang bas lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes skyes par bsam/ de ltar dkar cha babs nas dmar chas dbab pa ni/ a shad las byang chub kyi sems bdud rtsi dmar po drod dang bde ba'i rang bzhin can gyi rgyun babs pas lte ba'i 'khor lo dang gsang ba'i 'khor lo dang rkang mthil yan chad gang bas dga' ba'i ye shes rgyud la skye bar bsam/ de nas rim bzhin gyen du phyur te snying ga'i 'khor lo gang bas mchog dga'/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo lag sor gyi rtse tshun gang bas khyad dga'/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo gang bas lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa dang*/ rtsa phran thams cad dang ba spu'i khung bu tshun gyi lus nang thams cad khyab cing gang nas dkar dmar 'dres pa bde stong zung 'jug gi ye shes skyes par bsam/ bde ba dngos su skye ba'i tshe ngos bzung*/ de'i tshe thig le dkar dmar 'dres pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi dmigs pa tsam ma yin par haṃ dang a shad dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dang rdo rje phag mo yab yum/ thabs dang shes rab/ bde ba dang drod/ dbyings dang ye shes rnams kha sbyor ram/ zung 'jug gi bde ba/ bde ba'i ngo bo stong pa ste/ bde stong dbyer med kyi ngang du bzhag mthar rlung phyir btang ba dang mnyam du sbyor ba drug ldan gyis 'dren byas la byang sems dkar dmar thams cad yar log nas haṃ yig la thim par bsam pa ni 'dren pa'o// slar yang haṃ las byang sems dkar dmar char ltar babs pa'i rgyun gyis rtsa 'khor lus dang bcas pa gang zhing khyab par bsam pa ni bkram pa'o// gegs sel la gnyis las/ dang po tsha ba'i gegs sel ni/ tshad shas che ba'i rigs 'bar dmigs dang*/

drod kyi bogs 'don gnad du bsnun drag pas tshad pa lhong ba sogs byung na bya ste/ stong ra rtsa 'khor haṃ yig dang bcas pa bsil ba'i nyams can du gsal btab pa'i spyi bo pad zla la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang dkar po zla ba chu shel gyi rang bzhin dang 'od zer can/ phyag na chu shel gyi bum pa bdud rtsi bsil ba'i rang bzhin can gyis gang ba 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya drug sogs rgyan gyis spras pa/ mchog gsum rtsa gsum kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bsgom la/ khyab bdag dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs so// tsha ba'i nad dang tsha ba'i gegs thams cad zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ chu rlung grang mo so bar nas bzhar te 'jam por mnan la/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyi rgyal ba'i byin rlabs snod bcud kyi dwangs ma thams cad bdud rtsi bsil ba'i rang bzhin du bsdus nas bla ma'i phyag gi bum par thim pas de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun lud pa tshangs bug nas zhugs pa dang*/ haṃ las kyang bdud rtsi zla ba zhun ma lta bu chu rgyun ltar bsil ba grang s-i li li babs pas rtsa 'khor lus dang bcas pa thams cad yongs su gang nas chu shel gyi bum pa 'o mas gang ba ltar gyur pa bsil ba'i zer gyis snod bcud thams cad khyab par bsam la gong bshad ltar chu rlung bzung mthar bla ma haṃ la bstim nas mnyam par bzhag go /gnyis pa grang ba'i gegs sel ni/ grang shas che ba'i rigs 'dzag dmigs dang bde ba'i bogs 'don sgom drag pas grang ba bslang ba sogs byung na bya ste/ yi dam gyi sku rtsa 'khor a shad dang bcas pa gsal ba'i spyi bor pad nyi la bla ma rdo rje 'chang nyi ma me shel gyi rang bzhin dang 'od zer can/ phyag na me shel gyi bum pa bdud rtsi dmar po ser lhog lhog tu khol bas gang ba 'dzin pa/ rgyan chas yongs su rdzogs par bsgoms la/ khyab bdag dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs so// grang ba'i nad dang grang ba'i gegs thams cad zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

zhes gsol ba gdab/ me rlung drag la thung bar rngub cing bzung la bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od kyis rgyal ba'i byin rlabs snod bcud kyi dwangs ma thams cad me'i rang bzhin du bsdus nas phyag gi bum par thim pa de las bdud rtsi me'i rnam pa can babs pa a shad la thim pas shes rab ye shes kyi me bo che de stobs rgyas nas me'i dga' 'khyil lam me'i 'khor lo'i rnam par gyur te 'ur sgra dang bcas g.yon du 'khor ba las/ raṃ yig gi tshwa tshwa dmar tha ra ra 'phros pa las dro ba'i ngad dang tsha ba'i dbal mi bzod pa'i me ches cher 'bar bas rtsa 'khor lus dang bcas pa'am snying kha man chad gang bar bsam la me rlung bzung mthar bla ma a shad la bstim nas mnyam par bzhag go /de ltar gong 'og gnyis kyis tsha grang gi gegs thams cad nges par zhi ba the tshom me do// gnyis pa 'og zag med bde chen du spar nas 'og sgo'i bcud 'don pa ni/ zin dang brtan pas shes rab snyoms par zhugs/ zhes pa nas/ mi rtog pas/ zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan te/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa rlung lnga dbang du byed pa/ bum pa can rnams la ring du 'bad cing gtum mo 'bar 'dzag gi rnal 'byor rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas/ rgyu ba/ ring thung*/ shugs/ kha dog stobs rnams rim gyis zin nas/ rlung lnga rang mal du zin pa'i rtags dngos nyams rmi lam du 'byung ste/ sa rlung zin pas du ba/ chu rlung zin pas smig rgyu/ me rlung zin pas me khyer/ rlung gi rlung zin pas skya reng*/ nam mkha' rlung zin pas sprin med pa'i nam mkha' lta bu 'byung*/ dbu ma'i mas sna bye nas 'og thur sel gyi rlung dbu mar tshud/ yas sna bye nas srog gi rlung dbu mar tshud de lte 'og dbu ma'i nang du srog thur gong bu gcig tu 'dres/ des dbu ma'i nang gi gtum mo dngos 'bad rtsol la ma ltos par rang shug gis 'bar ba rgyun mi 'chad cing gtum mo'i rba rlabs brtan pas bde ba'i rang bzhin can gyi drod mthug pos lus thams cad khyab/

des dbu ma'i nang gi haṃ yig dngos las byang chub kyi sems 'babs pa rgyun mi 'chad pas/ mnyam rjes thams cad du bde ba chen po rnam par mi rtog pa'i rang bzhin can rgyun mi 'chad pa 'byung*/ de yi tshe rlung sems dbu mar tshud cing thig le gsang gnas su sleb pa na brtan pa'i phyir lte ba/ snying ga mgrin pa/ spyi bo/ gsang gnas rnams su bum pa can bcings pas thig le gsang ba lte ba snying ga mgrin pa/ spyi bo gang ba 'dzin nus pas mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi brtan/ de'i tshe rlung sems thig le ro gcig tu 'dres nas gnas pa rtsa lnga'i mdud pa thams cad zhig ste rtsa thams cad dhu ti dang*/ rlung thams cad ye shes kyi rlung du gyur nas khyad par rtags ni/ lte bar sa rlung brtan pas 'dug tshugs shing sa gzhi gser dang*/ zla zer dang*/ thang chen po mthong*/ snying khar chu rlung brtan pas lus dngul du snang zhing snang ba chu dang nyi zer dang 'od dmar po mthong*/ mgrin par me rlung brtan pas drod rgyas te gos mi dgos/ me chen po dang glog gi zer ma lta bu mthong*/ spyi bor rlung gi rlung brtan pas stobs che zhing 'gro mgyogs/ rlung dang 'ja' tshon mthong*/ gsang gnas su nam mkha'i rlung brtan pas lus bde zhing mdangs dang ldan/ nyi zla 'dres pa'i thig le sngo dwangs mthong ba dang*/ rlung sems dbu mar zhugs pas ba spu'i khung thams cad nas 'od zer lnga 'phro zhing lus 'ja' tshon sna lngas bskor ba dang*/ sa'i yon tan sred med kyi bu'i stobs thob/ chu'i yon tan mes bsregs kyang mi tshigs/ mes phyi rol gyi dngos po 'byin sdud nus shing chur mi bying*/ rlung gis lus shing bal ltar yangs shing rkang mgyogs 'grub/ nam mkhar 'phur ba dang ri brag la thogs pa med/ zla ba'i rlung gis khams dwangs mar 'gyur nas grib ma mi 'byung zhing chu bo gyen du ldog nus/ nyi ma'i rlung gis snyigs ma dag nas lus gzhan gyis mi mthong zhing nyi ma stod la gnon/

thams cad kun tu son pa'i yon tan skuu'i yon tan bu ga dgu'i rlung 'pho ba dang*/ gsung gi sgo 'byung ba bzhi tha dad pa'i lus byed pa 'gags te/ thugs kyi sgo smin mtshams dang snying ga'i gnad kyis sgo gnyis bye nas sngar mi shes pa'i chos thams cad shes shing tshig don mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob/ phra ba la sogs pa'i dbang phyug gi yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'i gzugs kyi mkha' spyod 'grub par 'gyur ro// gsum pa 'khor 'das rgyun gcod sbar nas rtsa rlung gi ching ston pa ni/ nyon mongs rang zhi bde gsal rgyun mi 'chad/ ngo bo mthong nas chos sku'i ngang du grol/ zhes par/ g.yon phung po lnga'i rlung de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ g.yas khams lnga'i rlung de bzhin gshegs ma'i rang bzhin dbu ma'i nang du thim pas/ nyon mongs pa dug lnga ma spangs rang sar dag cing*/ rnam smin gyi rtsa ye shes kyi rtsa la thim pas gsal ba rgyun gyi rtag pa/ rnam smin gyi rlung ye shes kyi rlung la thim pas mi rtog pa rgyun gyi rtag pa/ rnam smin gyi thig le dwangs ma ye shes kyi thig le la thim pas bde ba rgyun gyi rtag pa/ des rtsa gsal stong*/ rlung rig stong*/ thig le bde stong rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su sbyor bas/ chos su gnyug ma'i tsaṇḍā li ye nas gnas pa de'i ngo bo mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur ro// de ltar gtum mo bsgom pa'i skabs su drod kyi dam tshig 'bar ba'i rnal 'byor la ma chags par 'bad pa dang*/ 'khyags pa yid la mi byed/ grang ba byung rung mi zhum par bogs 'don sgom/ pags rigs dang gos mang brtsegs dang phu dung can mi gyon/ skom grang mi 'thung me dang nyi ma spangs/ bde ba'i dam tshig 'dzag pa'i rnal 'byor ma chags par bsgom/ bde ba'i nyams mi brjed par skyong*/ chags sred kyi rtog pa rang gar mi btang bar bde stong gi rtsis 'dzin la bogs 'don sgom/

gan rkyal du mi nyal sa rlon la mi 'dug rta drag tu mi rgyug sga g.yer/ za sgog nya sha/ sha rul/ chang skyur/ tshwa ches pa rnams spangs/ thun mong gi dam tshig tu zas bcud can brten/ spyod lam gzab cing grib kyi rigs la 'dzem/ gtum mo'i 'khrul 'khor rnams ma chags par bya zhing lhag par 'gro ba dang nyal ba'i skabs 'gro ba'i 'khrul 'khor dang*/ nyal ba'i 'khrul 'khor rtag par ma brjed par bya'o// gnyis pa sgyu lus chos brgyad rang grol na/ི bogs 'don sgyu lus chos brgyad rang grol la/ zhes pa/ yul can bde ba chen po nyid yul sgyu ma ltar 'char ba'i bogs 'don par byed pas na sgyu lus te/ de'i sgra don yang*/ rnam pa med kyang rnam pa sna tshogs 'dzin pa'am snang yang rang bzhin ma grub pa'i phyir sgyu ma'i lus zhes bya'o// de la bzhi/ ma dag pa'i sgyu lus/ dag pa'i sgyu lus/ rnam dag sgyu lus/ 'bras bu thob tshul lo// dang po ni/ 'khor 'das thams cad sgyu mar shes bya ste/ zhes pa ste/ khams gsum brtan g.yo mthong reg gi dngos po ma dag pa'i snang ba 'di thams cad snang yang bden par ma grub pas na ma dag sgyu ma dang*/ de ltar ma rtogs te bden dngos su zhen pa'i mtshan 'dzin spong byed kyi thabs la de'i man ngag tu brjod pa ste/ de la spyir sbyang pa ni/ khams gsum snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i phyi nang gi dngos po 'khor 'das kyi snang ba 'di thams cad snang bzhin du bden par ma grub pa rmi lam dang sgyu ma dang 'ja' tshon dang chu zla la sogs pa lta bu'o// snyam du dpes gtan la 'bebs shing bsgom mo// 'di ltar snang ba'i dngos po'i chos rnams ni/ zhes pa nas/ grub pa med/ ces pa'i bar gyis bstan te/ snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i phyi nang gi dngos po 'khor 'das kyi snang ba thams cad bden zhing rtag go snyam pa byung na de'i tshe 'di ltar bsam te/ 'khor 'das kyi snang ba 'di thams cad bden zhing rtag pa zhig yod na gzhan du 'gyur mi rigs kyang de ltar min pa glo bur gyis 'gyur zhing*/

mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin can du 'dug pa dang*/ ma rig bag chags kyi 'khrul snang las shar ba yin pas don la/ grub pa gang yang med de/ gzugs la sogs pa 'di rnams sems 'khrul pa la snang ba phyi rol na med pa rmi lam dang rgyu ma lta bu/ rkyen las byung ba brag cha dang gzugs brnyan lta bu/ mi rtag pa zil pa dang chu bur lta bu/ snang la rang bzhin med pa smig rgyu dang 'ja' tshon lta bu ste/ sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad dang mtshungs par bsgom mo// bye brag tu sbyang pa ni/ gzugs rnams snang stong sgra rnams brag char ltos/ zhes pa nas/ zhen med spyod/ ces pa'i bar gyis bstan pa'i don/ dang po lus me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar sgyu mar sbyang pa ni/ de yang me long dwangs pa la/ rang gi bzhin/ bar na sgrib g.yogs med pa gsum tshogs pas gzugs brnyan 'char yang don la med pa bzhin du/ rang gi lus kyang pha ma'i rgyu rkyen dang*/ ma rig 'khrul pa'i rnam shes gsum tshogs pa'i dbang gis lus su grub kyang don la med de gzugs brnyan dang mtshungs pa'o snyam pa dang*/ gnyis pa ngag brag ca ltar sgyu mar sbyong ba ni/ lung khug dog po'i brag dang*/ mis 'bod pa'i skad gnyis tshogs pa las brag ca'i sgra 'byung yang don la med pa bzhin du/ lus sems brjod 'dod tshogs pa las ngag gi sgra skad 'byung yang don med de brag cha lta bu'o snyam pa dang*/ gsum pa sems 'ja' tshon ltar sgyu mar sbyong ba ni/ 'ja' tshon kha dog gsal yang stong pa'i rang bzhin las ma 'das pa ltar sems kyi rtsal snang sna tshogs su snang yang bden med stong gsal gyi rang bzhin no snyam pas lus ngag yid gsum sgyu mar sbyong*/ skabs su me long dri ma med pa mdun du bzhag pa la rang gi gzugs 'char du bcug nas/ de la bstod smad/ bde mi bde/ snyan mi snyan/ sbyin 'phrog ste 'jig rten chos brgyad dang 'brel ba'i gtam byas pas dga' mi dga' 'am chags sdang e 'dug bltas pas ji ltar brjod kyang me long gi gzugs brnyan la dga' mi dga' dang chags sdang med pa bzhin du rang la'ang sbyar te/

de'ang rang gi lus 'di snang yang bden par ma grub pa gzugs brnyan dang chos mtshungs pas/ bstod smad/ bde mi bde/ snyan mi snyan/ sbyin 'phrog gang la'ang dga' mi dga' dang*/ chags sdang bya don mi 'dug snyam pas gzhan gyis bstod ra gtong ba la dga' ba dang*/ smad ra gtong ba la zhe mi sdang zhing*/ de bzhin du chos brgyad ro snyoms/ gal te ro mi snyom par 'dug na/ yon tan de dag yod nas bstod na brjed pas lhag tu mi 'gro bas dga' bar mi rigs/ med nas bstod na tshig stong gi phye gtor gyis gang yang mi phan pas dga' don med/ skyon de yod nas smad na rang la de ltar yod pa gzhan gyis drangs por brjod pa tsam la zhe sdang don ci yang med/ med nas smad na des gang yang mi gnod pas zhe sdang mie dgos snyam du bsgom/ snyan mi snyan la'ang de dang 'dra bar sgom/ bde skyid la dga' ba la lus bem po'i ro dang*/ ngag brag cha dang*/ sems nam mkha' stong pa dang 'dra bas bde rgyu dang skyid rgyu gang yang med/ med pa la yod par 'dzin pa'i 'khrul snang gis mgo 'khor bar 'dug bsam pa dang*/ sdug bsngal la'ang de bzhin du shes par bya/ rnyed pa la dga' na nor rdzas 'di dgra 'dre'i g.yab mo bsrung brkyang sogs sdug bsngal gyi gzhi ma/ lan gcig 'byor kyang tha mar rgud pa mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin yin pas 'khrul pa'i mgo bskor du 'dug bsam pa dang ma rnyed na mi dga' ba mi dgos te nor med na dgra dang bral zhing bsrung gsog mi dgos pas dal la sngar bsags kyi bsod nams mi 'dzad pas a re dga' bsam/ de rnams kyi bogs 'don du 'chi ba snying la zug pa zhig bsgoms pas zhen pa dbang med du ldog cing snyoms las le lor mi sdod/ chags sdang ngang gis grol ba zhig yong ngo*// gnyis pa dag pa'i sgyu lus ni/ snod bcud ma dag pa'i snang ba rnam par dag pa lha'i dkyil 'khor du bsgyur nas nyams su blangs ba'i don gyis na dag pa'i sgyu lus zhes bya la/

de'ang phung khams skye mched thams cad gdod nas lha'i rang bzhin du grub pa de nyid ma rtogs pa rtogs phyir yin lugs gtan la phab ste bsgom pas sgyu 'phrul gyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can 'char te snod bcud ltar gsal bas tha mal gyi snang zhen sbyangs shing lha yang snang stong sgyu ma lta bur gtan la phab pas gya noms lhar zhen gyi rtog pa sbyang bar byed pa'i rim pa ste/ rang nyid dpal 'khor lo sdom pa yum dang bcas pa'i bskyed rim rgyu ma lta bu bsgom la rnam pa gsal zhing rnam dag dran pa/ nga rgyal brtan pa/ ngo bo stong pa rang bzhin dbyer med nyams bde ba chen po rnams kyis rgyas btab/ skabs su 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum mam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku 'gying log tu bris pa me long nang du 'char bcug nas de la mig shes rtse gcig tu bzung*/ yid yul du 'char bder gyur pa na me long dang rang gi bar du de 'dra ba yid kyis bsgom/ de la goms pa dang*/ rang de 'dra ba bsgom la/ mthar snang tshad kyang de bzhin du sgom/ de thams cad kyang rang gi blos btag pa tsam ma gtogs bden par ma grub pa sgyu ma lta bu dang*/ chu zla dang*/ mig yor dang*/ smig rgyu dang*/ rmi lam dang*/ brag cha dang*/ dri za'i grong khyer dang*/ mig 'phrul dang*/ 'ja' tshon dang*/ glog dang*/ chu bur dang*/ me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu ste sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis dang mtshungs par bsgom pa la bslab bo// gsum pa rnam dag sgyu lus sam rdzogs rim sgyu lus ni/ dag pa'i sgyu lus tha mal gyi snang ba bsal te lhar bsgom pa tsam gyis dag par bzhag kyang*/ ngo bo rtog pas btag pa'i bsgom pa yin phyir shin tu rnam dag min la/ 'di rlung sems kyi dwangs ma las grub pa'i lus/ rtog pas ma btags par pra phabs pa ltar snang ba yin pas rnam dag sgyu lus sam rdzogs rim sgyu lus zhes brjod pa ste/ sngags bla med thun mong ma yin pa'i sbas don gyi sgyu lus rlung sems bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i lam gyi rim pa dngos yin zhing*/

de'ang tsaṇḍā li'i 'bar snang mthar phyin pa las ye shes kyi rlung mchog gi a wa dhu tir thim pa'i 'bar 'dzag gi zhu bde rgyun mi 'chad pa las mchog gi dga' ba bzhi skye/ de las sems dben khyad par can skye ba las khyad par lnga ldan gyi sgyu lus tsam po ba 'grub/ de don gyi 'od gsal gyis dri bral du byas pa'i mthar sgyu lus khyad par can 'grub pa de nyid zung 'jug gi sku zhes brjod do// de ltar lam du bya ba la gnyis/ mnyam bzhag sgyu lus dang rjes thob sgyu lus so// dang po mnyam bzhag sgyu lus la gnyis las/ dang po mtshan med sgyu lus ni/ lus dben rnam snang gi chos bdun gyis 'khod la/ rang nyid 'khor lo sdom pa zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa yum rdo rje rnal 'byor mas 'khyud pa 'khor dang bcas par bsgom na legs shing mi nus na lhan skyes yab yum du gsal ba'i lus nang rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi a haṃ dang bcas pa gsal ba'i snying ga'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ mthing ka 'od lnga 'phro ba bsgom/ spyi bor padma nyi zla sgra gcan bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan la phung po khams skye mched las dbang bya ba dang bcas gdan gsum lhar gdod nas grub pa/ rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi 'char gzhi/ skyabs gsum 'dus pa/ dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' he ru kaḥnam mkha' mdog can spyan gsum pa yid tsam khros pa'i nyams can phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri thod bsnams pa la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan zhing stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ snang stong 'ja' tshon gyi sku can 'od zer gyi phung po 'bar bar bzhugs par bsam/ khong stong khyod kyi sku la med/ sogs kyis phyag 'tshal/ rang rig bla mar rtogs pas phyag 'tshal lo// sogs kyis yan lag bdun pa 'bul/

khyab bdag dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs so// dag pa'i sgyu lus zung 'jug 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku myur du 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ bla ma yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas byang chub sems dkar dmar gyi rgyun chen po babs/ rang gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi sogs lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ dag pa'i sgyu lus 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku 'grub par byin gyis brlab par bsam/ mthar bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam/ ngag dben rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i bum pa can bya/ sems dben dmigs pa hūm̐ la gtad de rlung dbu mar dril ba'i 'bar 'dzag gi sbyor bas mchog gi dga' bzhi bskyed pas nyams snang skyed de/ sa chur thim pas du ba/ chu mer thim pas smig rgyu/ me rlung la thim pas me khyer/ rlung sems la thim pas mar me/ sems sems byung la thim pas zla snang*/ sems byung ma rig par thim pas nyi snang*/ ma rig pa thams cad stong par thim pas sgra gcan gyi snang ba/ de nas thams cad stong pa sprin med nam mkha' lta bu 'char slar snang gsum lug ldog tu 'char te thams cad stong pa las ma rig pa/ de las sems byung*/ de las sems/ sems rlung dang bcas pa las dpe bcu gnyis kyis mtshon pa'i sgyu ma'i sku 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum zhal phyag yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa so so rang rig gi ye shes kyi ngor mngon sum du 'char la/ der ma zad dus gsum gyi snod bcud dag ma dag thams cad sgrib bral du mthong ba snyam byed de/ blo'i bye brag gis rim dang thod rgal cig car ci rigs su 'char ba yod do// gnyis pa mtshan bcas sgyu lus ni/ gong smos tsaṇḍa lī'i rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i gzhi dben gsum khyad par ba legs par grub nas rig ma mtshan ldan las kyi phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sprul pa yid kyi phyag rgya la snyoms par zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis zag med lus kyi rgyu rigs gdod nas gnas pa nyid snang gsum lug 'byung dang*/

lug ldog 'od gsal bcas pa rdo rje gsum du shar bas sgrib bral du byas te/ rdul phra rab kyi chos nyid las 'das shing*/ rlung sems kyi dwangs ma las grub pa'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa'i mtshan dpes spras pa me long gi gzugs bsnyan lta bu snang la rang bzhin med pa/ dngos dngos med/ gnyis ka gnyis min gyi mu bzhi las grol ba/ phung khams skye mched kyi mtshan mas ma gos pa/ yid kyi rang bzhin ye shes kyi sku tsam du snang ba/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid kyi gzugs dwangs gsal thogs pa med pa 'ja' tshon lta bu 'grub par 'gyur ro/ 'di ni gsang 'dus kyi rim pa lnga'i gsum pa bdag byin rlabs dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi sor bsam las byung ba'i stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo rnam kun mchog ldan rnams dang don gcig ste/ slob bshad las byung ba'i sbas don shin tu zab pa snyan rgyud kyi gdams ngag yin pa'i phyir khrid yig rnams kyis dkyus su ma brtan par gud du sbas pas mkhas pa glegs bam gyis khengs pa rnams kyis kyang ji bzhin ma rtogs te rnam par 'khyams so/ gsum pa rjes thob sgyu lus ni/ de ltar mnyam bzhag tu sgyu ma'i sku la gsal snang phyin nas rjes thob tu tha mal gyi snang ba thams cad sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis lam du khyer bar bya'o// sbas don gyi sgyu lus 'di rtsa ba'i tshig zin la dngos su med kyang 'bras bu thob tshul gyi tshig rkang gcig po de'i shugs las bstan pa yin no// bzhi pa 'bras bu thob tshul ni/ 'ja' lus chos kyi sku ni thob par 'gyur/ zhes pa de ltar rnam dag sgyu lus 'di bsgoms pas rgyal po ind+ra bhu ti dang 'dra bar snyigs ma'i lus sbrul gyi lpags pa bzhin du brjes te 'ja' tshon gyi lus yon tan brgyad dang ldan par gyur nas mthar thug mi slob pa'i zung 'jug shin tu rnam par dag pa'i go 'phang mchog la dbugs 'byin thob par 'gyur ro// gsum pa lam gyi tshod 'dzin rmi lam 'khrul pa rang sangs ni/

mtshan dus rmi lam 'phrul pa rang sangs ni/ zhes pa lam rnams kyi drod tshad rmi lam du myong ba brtan mi brtan gyis tshod 'dzin par byed pas lam gyi tshod 'dzin rmi lam gyi rnal 'byor te/ bag chags kyi rang gzugs 'char bas sam yul gyi srog gzugs 'dzin pa'i phyir rmi lam zhes bya'o// de yang rtsa gnas su rlung sems 'du tshul gyi khyad par gyis rmi lam 'byung la/ de'i lus ni rang lus 'di las bye ma bye gnyis 'byung yang*/ ngo bo rlung sems kyi lus te/ de'ang da lta'i lus kyi bag chags kyi rjes su 'brang bas bag chags kyi lus zhes kyang bya zhing*/ dus der da lta'i kun rdzob kyi snang ba 'khrul pa 'di'i bag chags kyi dbang gis kun rdzob tu'ang ma grub pa'i snang ba sna tshogs 'char bas nying 'khrul te/ de lam du khyer ba rmi lam gyi gdams pa la gsum/ rmi lam bzung ba/ sbyang ba/ 'bras bu'o// dang po bzung ba la/ bzung ba dngos dang*/ gegs sel gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sgo gsum 'bad pas dran pa'i lcags dkyus bzungs/ zhes pa/ nyin par gyi dus su/ lus gnad rnam snang gi chos bdun bcas nas/ rang nyid 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum mam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi ldan du gsal ba'i mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus dbu ma'i nang du pad nyi'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid rgyal ba thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas padma dmar po dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pas yum gos dkar mo dmar mo padma dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas kyis brgyan zhing padma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi gtsug dbu ma'i nang nas yas sna'i bar du brgyud pa'i bla ma tho brtsegs su bzhugs pa phra la dwangs shing gsal bar bsgoms la/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen la gsol ba 'debs/

rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba 'debs/ grub chen te lo pa la= mkhas pa nā ro paṇa chen= mar pa chos kyi blo gros= mi la bzhad pa rdo rje= ras chung rdo rje grags pa= snyan rgyud rgyud pa'i bla ma= drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// rmi lam gegs nad sel bar byin gyis rlobs// rmi lam sgyu mar 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba btab mthar brgyud pa'ibla ma rnams rim bzhin 'od du zhu nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim par bsam/ khyab bdag dpal ldan bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ rmi lam gegs nad sel bar= rmi lam sgyu mar 'byongs bar= zhes gsol ba mang du gdab/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer dmar po 'phros pas phyi snod kyi 'jig rten 'od zer dmar po'i gzhal yas khang dang*/ nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad bla ma gsung rdo rje snang ba mtha' yas kyi rang bzhin du lam gyis gyur par bsam/ bla ma yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgra dang 'od zer gyis/ snod bcu dag pa'i rang bzhin de tshur 'dus te mgrin pa'i bla ma la thim par bsam/ rlung ro lan gsum bsal nas/ rngub pa na 'byung lnga'i rlung ro rkyang brgyud de dbu mar zhugs pas ye shes kyi rlung dang 'dres te nor bu'i bu ga nas mgrin pa'i bar ye shes kyi rlung dmar la dwangs pas yongs su gang bar bsam/ dgang ba dang gzhil ba'i tshe dmigs pa de kha dang*/ mgrin par gtad cing rlung sems mgrin par gcun/ btang ba'i dus bla ma'i sku las 'phros pa'i 'od sna sgo brgyud de song bas rgyal ba zhi khro 'khor bcas mchod/ de rnams kyi gsung rdo rje'i byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par bsdus/ rngub pa na 'byung lnga'i rlung bcas ro rkyang brgyud de dbu ma gang bas rmi lam gyi gnas skabs 'khrul pa'i dri ma thams cad dag par mos/ de lta bu'i spro bsdu dang bcas rlung khug pa brgya rtsa sogs bya'o// de nas snang grags dran pa'i lcags kyus bzung ba ni/

'di ltar snang ba thams cad rmi lam gyi rang bzhin kho nar 'dug snyam pa las ma g.yos par bya/ de nas gnyid khar stong ra dang bla ma bsgom pa spro bsdu dang*/ rlung bzung ba bcas sngar ltar byas la/ gnyid mthug na tsog pu dang*/ srab na gzhog g.yas pa sa la phab/ lag g.yas pa'i mthe'u chung gis sna bug g.yas bkag la/ mthe bong gis ske yi 'phar rtsa sdom nas seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis nyal la/ bla mar rmi lam zin pa'i gsol ba drag tu gdab/ rmi lam rmi bar bya zhing rmi ba de'ang ngos zin par bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag tu bya'o// mgrin pa'i bla ma dang*/ gnyid 'thug na snying gar sgron me shin tu gsal ba de yi 'od kyis lus phyi nang snang srid thams cad gsal ba la sems bzung*/ srab na thig le nag po la sems bzung nas ma yengs par gnyid log la rmi lam bzung ngo*// gnyis pa gegs sel ni/ gnyid tsam nas sad pa'am zin 'phro la sad na ni sad 'byams te/ dam tshig nyams chags bshags shing rdor sems sgom bzlas dang*/ dbang bzhi len pa/ tshogs 'khor la 'bad/ zas drod bcud ldan pa brten/ dmigs pa ni/ gzhan rnams gong ltar la/ snying gar thig le nag po ril ma tsam gcig yod pa de mchod nas rang lus de'i nang du tshud par bsam/ gnyid ma phebs pa'am pheb kyang rmi lam mi 'byung ba ni stong 'byams te/ 'dun pa cung klod cing snying gar muṃ nag po/ de'i 'od kyis phyi rol thams cad mun nag thibs se song bar bsam la nyal rmi lam mi gsal bas mi zin pa'am yad yud re zin yang shugs mi thon pa ni brjed 'byams te/ grib sel gyi cho ga bya zhing*/ zas 'grangs ches pa dang*/ gos mthug po mi gyon/ tsog gnyid byed cing*/ smin mtshams su thig le dmar po 'od 'tsher bu la sems gtad de nyal/ lan re tsam zin yang slar rmi lam gyi rgyun la 'khrul pa ni 'khrul 'byams te/ sgrib sbyang dang tshogs bsags la 'bad dgos pas/ sgrib sbyong khyad par ba ni/

a thung rdo rje snyems ma'i rang bzhin las spros pa'i mes phung khams skye mched kyi ma dag pa'i sgrib tshogs bsregs pa dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag nyid haṃ yig gi bdud rtsis bkrus shing sbyangs par mos pa'i gtum mo'i rnal 'byor sgom/ tshogs bsags khyad par ba ni/ rang gi rnam shes rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rang bzhin du spyi bo nas 'phos pa nam mkhar gnas par bsam la/ gsung rdo rjes rmi lam 'khrul pa'i gnas skabs gzhom pa'i mtshon byed padma dmar po'i yu ba can gyi gri gug mgrin par gnas pa de drag tu 'khor bas tha mal gyi lus sil bur gtub pa rang byung gi ka pā la'i snod du gnas pa'i 'og nas thod sgyed kyis btegs pa/ me 'bar te thod pa dros pas sha khrag zhu ba'i khar 'bru gsum gnas pa'i 'od kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rnam par bsdus te thims pas ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur par bsam/ rang sems rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par nam mkhar gnas pa'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis mgron bzhi 'khor lo gsum gyi lha'i ngo bor spyan drangs pa la/ rang sems rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka nas mchod pa'i lha mo spros pa'i lag thod kyis bdud rtsi drang bas dgyes par bsam/ mthar 'khor gsum yongs dag gi ngang du mnyam par bzhag /gegs sel dngos ni/ rang stong ra rtsa 'khor dang bcas par gsal ba'i spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma snang ba mtha' yas yab yum gyi rnam par bzhugs pa la gsol ba gdab/ bla ma tshangs bug nas byon te dpral bar 'od zer dmar po'i klong du bzhugs par bsam pa dang*/ mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus su padma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar hūm̐ dmar po/ 'dab ma bzhi la a nu ta ra zhes pa'i yig 'bru re re g.yon bskor tu bkod pa g.yas su 'khor bar bsam la/ a nu ta ra hūm̐ zhes bzla/ mthar a nu ta ra dbus kyi hūm̐ la bsdus te dmigs pa hūm̐ la gtad de nyal bas zin no// des kyang ma zin na spog pa ni/

srod la sngar ltar bsgoms nas tho rang thig le dkar po gos su bgo ste/ dpral shar thig le dkar po gsal zhing 'tsher ba bsgom nas/ de'i 'od kyis lus stod phyi nang ril por khyab par bsam la/ rlung khug dang rmi lam 'dzin pa'i 'dun pa thengs bcu gcig byas te gnyid/ da dung yang zin dka' na/ srod la nyams len bshad ma thag pa ltar dang*/ tho rangs thig le nag po gdan du 'dings te/ gsang gnas su thig le nag po nag la 'tsher ba zhig bsgom nas/ de'i 'od kyis lus smad phyi nang ril po khyab par bsam la/ rlung khug dang 'dun pa thengs nyer gcig byas la nyal bas nges par zin no// de yang skabs rer rmi lam rmi lam du shes pa tsam/ gdams pa med pa dang*/ 'dzin pa'i rtsol ba ma byas pa la'ang 'byung bas brtag mi thub la/ 'dir ni 'dzin pa'i rtsol bas zin pa dang*/ zin pa de'ang yun ring du brtan pa zhig dgos so// gnyis pa sbyang ba la gsum las dang po rtsal sbyang ba ni/ zin sbyang spel bsgyur sprul zhing gegs rnams bsal/ zhes pa/ rmi lam zin nas sbyang dgos te/ spel ba ni/ rmi lam du gang snang ba de nyid gcig las gnyis/ gnyis las/ bzhi sogs brgya stong mang por spel/ bsgyur ba ni/ yul gang snang de gzhan du bsgyur te/ dur 'gro rmis pa mir bsgyur ba dang*/ mi lta bu rta dang khang khyim gzhal yas khang dang*/ sa chur bsgyur ba dang*/ chu mer bsgyur ba dang*/ gcig mang por bsgyur ba dang*/ mang po gcig tu bsgyur ba/ yod pa mi snang bar bya ba dang*/ med pa yod par bsgyur ba sogs bya'o// rmi lam zin pa na rang rgyal po dang bram ze la sogs pa mi rigs dang*/ seng ge dang stag dang khyung la sogs pa dang*/ ri dang khang pa ljon shing 'byung bzhi sogs su sprul pa dang*/ 'jigs skrag sogs byung na de'i gnyen por sprul pa dang*/ snod bcud mi snang bar bya ba la sogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul la bslab bo// de dag gi dus mos gus chung ba/

dam tshig nyams pa/ dngos zhen che ba/ grib kyis phog pa sogs gegs thams cad mi 'byung bar bya la/ byung na gong du bshad pa la sogs pa'i sel thabs la 'bad do// gnyis pa sgyu mar byin gyis brlab pa ni/ nyi zla zhon dang zhing khams mtha' dag bsgrod/ ces pa ste/ rmi lam rmi dus rang lha skur bsgom pa'am sems nyid hūm̐ sngon po'i rnam par spyi bo nas 'phos la/ yi dam gyi skur bsgyur ba nyi zla'i steng du gnas pa dang*/ mngon par dga' ba la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang 'dod pa der song nas sangs rgyas mchod cing chos nyan pa dang*/ sems can gyi don byed pa sogs la bslab bo// gzhan yang nyin par rang gi mgrin par 'od kyi thig le dmar po de'i nang du gang 'dod pa'i zhing khams mig 'bras la gzugs brnyan 'char ba ltar bsgoms nas dmigs pa rtse gcig tu gtad la rlung bzung*/ nyal khar de bzhin bsgoms nas 'dun pa dang bcas te gnyid log pas rmi lam du zhing khams der bsgrod pa tshegs med par nus so/ khyad par lha sku sgyu ma lta bu la bslab dgos pas rmi lam zin ma thag tu dag pa'i sgyu lus sgom pa dang*/ lhag par rnam dag sgyu lus rtse gcig tu sgom pa ni rmi lam gyi rnal 'byor gyi mthil so yin no/ gsum pa rmi lam gyi de kho na nyid la bslab pa ni/ bzang ngan sgyu ma cir snang rang grol ltos// zhes pa rmi lam gyi snang ba rmi lam du shes pa dang*/ rmi lam bden par ma grub par nges pa tsam gyis gang yang mi phan pas de kho na nyid kyis rtsis zin par bya dgos te/ rmi lam gyi snang ba bzang ngan med pa sems kyi rnam 'phrul/ sems nyid gdod ma nas skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bral ba rang shar rang grol shes par bya zhing*/ rang rig gi ngo bo rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes nyid la mnyam par bzhag par bya'o// gsum pa 'bras bu ni/ mthar phyin sa bcu non nas bde chen thob/ ces pa de ltar bsgoms pas 'khor ba gzhi med du grol nas rang sems chos skur rtsal 'byongs pas rmi lam lta bur sa bcu non nas 'tshang rgya'o// bzhi pa lam gyi snying po 'od gsal ma rig mun bral ni/

khyad par 'od gsal ma rig mun bral ni/ zhes pa chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bar rtogs pa nyid nyams len gyi rtsa ba yin pas lam gyi snying por gyur pa 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor te/ de'i sgra don ni/ gnas lugs 'gags med du gsal ba'am/ rang bzhin med kyang lhun grub tu snang ba'i phyir 'od gsal zhes bya ba yin no// de lam du bya ba la gsum/ nyin mo lam dang rang bzhin gcig tu bsre ba/ mtshan mo lam dang rang bzhin gcig tu bsre ba/ mthar phyin 'bras bu bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ rang nyid 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum lus nang rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi dang bcas par gsal ba'i snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus dbu ma'i nang du padma zla nyi sgra gcan brtsegs pa'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang he ru ka sku mdog sngon po spyan gsum zhi ma khro stag sham can/ rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ yum phag mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ zhabs rdor skyil gyis bzhugs pa'i sku dwangs gsal 'od du 'bar ba'i dbu gtsug nas yar dbu ma'i yas sne'i bug pa la reg gi bar brgyud pa'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang la thug gi bar tho brtsegs su bzhugs pa 'od zer sngon po shas cher 'phro ba'i sku can du gsal ba la/ snying rje chen po sems chen po/ sogs kyis phyag 'tshal/ rang sems bla mar rtogs pas sogs yan lag bdun pa bya/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen la gsol ba 'debs/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba 'debs/ grub chen te lo pa la= mkhas pa nā ro paṇa chen= mar pa chos kyi blo gros= mi la bzhad pa rdo rje= ras chung rdo rje grags pa la= snyan rgyud brgyud pa'i bla ma la= drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// dpe yi 'od gsal rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// don gyi 'od gsal mngon 'gyur byin gyi rlobs// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i sku 'grub byin gyis rlobs// zung 'jug go 'phang 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba btab mthar brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim par bsam la/

drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ dpe yi 'od gsal= sogs gong smos kyi gsol 'debs grangs bsags mthar bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med ngang du mnyam par bzhag /de nas snying ga'i 'khor lo'i dbus chos nyid kyi dbu ma'i nang du padma 'dab bzhi sngon po'i ze'u 'brur/ bla ma'i thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i bdag nyid hūm̐ sngon po/ mdun nas g.yas bskor gyis rnam snang rin 'byung 'od dpag med don grub gsum gyi rang bzhin a nu ta ra dkar ser dmar ljang 'od 'phro ba bsgoms la/ rlung ro lan gsum bsal nas snying ga'i bum pa can byed pa thob thang yin yang*/ ma byang bas der dmigs la dngos su lte bar bsdom pa gegs chung zhing*/ lan 'ga' tsam gyi ni 'gal ba med pas khug pa bdun du 'dzin pa'i gnyis gsum tsam snying ga'i dang*/ gzhan rnams lte ba'i bum can byed pa lta bu'o// dang por rngub dus sna sgo'i rlung kha dog lnga ldan ro rkyang nas brgyud snying ga'i bug pa 'dril mtshams nas dbu mar zhugs pa yig 'bru rnams la thim/ dbyung dus yig 'bru lnga las 'od zer rang mdog 'phros ro rkyang brgyud de song ba'i rtse las mchod pa'i lha mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros pas/ phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas he ru ka rigs lnga yab yum gyi dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa 'ba' zhig tu bzhugs pa rnams mchod/ rngub dus de kun las he ru ka rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du spyan drangs pa sna bug nas ro rkyang brgyud de snying ga'i bu ga nas dbu mar zhugs/ bsdom dus de rnams yi ge lnga so sor thim pas lhag par 'bar ba'i 'od kyis dug lnga khams lnga phung khams lnga sogs sbyang bya rnams sbyong nas sku lnga ye shes lnga 'grub nus su byas par bsam/ yang dbyung dus 'bru lnga las 'od zer rang mdog 'phros ro rkyang brgyud de sna bug nas thon te snod bcud thams cad la khyab pas ma dag pa thams cad sbyangs nas snod gzhal yas khang dang*/
